purpose: Prospective blinded A/B/A comparison of a computational subject against a conventional removable-head comparator under common measured duty.
authority_boundary: Planning only. This document does not authorize fabrication, purchase, lab booking, data collection, or external messaging.

containment.device: Candidate and comparator heads are inserts only; a separately engineered and pressure-rated containment assembly carries pressure loads.

comparator.selection: Freeze the best available conventional removable head before preregistration. CT-35 reconstruction is a research comparator only unless a responsible reviewer documents its provenance and applicability.
comparator.identity: Exact geometry hash, as-built subject hash, build passport, fluid batch, and measurement chain are bound per specimen.

pilot_power.method: Estimate paired percent-effect standard deviation from independent pilot build/preparation pairs; compute n with analysis/validation/v5 sample_size_from_pilot; round up and obtain statistician review.
pilot_power.power_inputs: Useful effect, alpha, power, paired pilot observations and their independent-unit identities are frozen before the confirmation sample size is accepted.
pilot_power.replication_unit: independently manufactured specimen paired within an independently prepared fluid batch; nominal repeats from one build or batch do not count.

design.blocks: Each independent unit uses blinded A1/B/A2 slots; the order of independent units and coded specimens is randomized from a committed allocation by a person outside measurement and analysis. The allocation stays concealed until data lock.
design.randomization: An independent statistician records the generator, seed commitment, permitted sequence and mapping custodian in the preregistration before the first unit; sequence disclosure occurs only after data lock.
design.A1: Comparator head; establish stabilization and collect common-duty data.
design.B: Candidate head; identical frozen duty, sampling locations, and measurement chain.
design.A2: Comparator repeat; a treated-oil concentration drift above 10% from A1 or pressure drift above 5% invalidates that paired block. These are the draft v1 drift limits and require approval in preregistration.
design.operator_blinding: Specimen coding hides candidate/comparator identity from analyzer, reduction analyst, and decision reviewer until data lock.
design.duty: Flow band, reject split, absolute and differential pressure limits, temperature, and control policy are frozen in a reviewed DecisionProfile before collection.

measurement.channels: Inlet/treated/reject oil concentration and volume-weighted DSD; feed/treated/reject flow; inlet/treated/reject pressure taps; temperature; oil and water inventory.
measurement.clock: One synchronized clock; record per-instrument and per-sample-line delay with calibration evidence. Corrected process time is instrument time minus measured delay.
measurement.calibration: Traceable pre/post calibration, span/zero, drift, sample recovery, analyzer LOQ, sample-line lag and mixing/recovery controls are required.
measurement.steady_window: Window edges, stabilization criterion, censoring rules and mass/volume alignment are preregistered. No extrapolation across missing or censored samples.

separation.calibration: Use calibration partition only for measurement/reduction and model calibration; preserve its manifest and hashes.
separation.holdout: Holdout labels and outcomes remain sealed until analysis code and DecisionProfile are frozen. Do not tune on holdout.
separation.independence: A preparation or specimen appearing in calibration cannot appear in holdout.

review_and_release.public_disclosure: Only deliberately reviewed allowlisted material may be exported; private subject/build evidence remains private.
